prose.subject: Friendly Reminder: Invoice INV-22841 for Greywater Robotics
prose.body:
Hi there,

Hope you're having a great week at Greywater Robotics!

This is just a quick, friendly nudge regarding our outstanding invoice INV-22841 for 3664.39 USDC. We know things get busy, so we wanted to give you a gentle heads-up to help us keep our records in order.

When you get a moment, please send the payment to our standard wallet address: 0x123a4a94c4e16702e9d8002febe995d19328447b.

As always, feel free to include the invoice number in the transaction memo so we can match it up quickly on our end. If you have any questions about the line items or need a copy of the invoice re-sent, just reply to this email and our team will sort you right out.

Thanks so much for your business and for keeping things moving with Pembury Logistics!

Best regards,

The Accounts Team
Pembury Logistics
